requests.title: Something with diamonds
requests.line: Something with diamonds in it. She'll know if it's fake.

requests.title: The car
requests.line: I've seen the one. It's yellow.

requests.title: Custom gold boots
requests.line: My initials on the heel.

requests.title: Fly my mum in
requests.line: Every home game. She's never seen me play.

requests.title: A personal chef
requests.line: I can't eat what's in that canteen.

requests.title: A studio at home
requests.line: I've got bars, boss. I need a booth.

requests.title: My cousin's wedding
requests.line: I said I'd pay. Loudly. In front of everyone.

requests.title: Matchday barber
requests.line: I can't go out there like this.

requests.title: A highlights drone
requests.line: My agent says I need content.

requests.title: Fix my old pitch
requests.line: The one I grew up on. New fence, new nets.

requests.title: Ship my car over
requests.line: It's been in a container for six months.

requests.title: A match back home
requests.line: One game in my old town. I'm not asking twice.

requests.title: Massage therapist
requests.line: The lads are stiff. Get someone in.

requests.title: Squad headphones
requests.line: Everyone. Matching. It's a unity thing.

requests.title: Charter the plane
requests.line: Six hours on a coach before a cup tie?

requests.title: Dressing room speakers
requests.line: The ones in there are a war crime.

requests.title: Barbecue at my place
requests.line: Everyone's coming. You're paying.

requests.title: A proper team photo
requests.line: A real photographer. Not your phone.

requests.title: Two weeks in the Bahamas
requests.line: Sun. Sea. Don't call me.

requests.title: My sister's wedding
requests.line: It's abroad. I'm giving a speech.

requests.title: A film cameo
requests.line: They want me on set. I have a LINE.

requests.title: National call-up
requests.line: My country called. I'm going.

requests.title: Grandmother's birthday
requests.line: She's ninety. I'm going home.

requests.title: A silent retreat
requests.line: A month in the mountains. No football.

requests.title: One big night out
requests.line: The whole squad. One night. Trust me.

requests.title: Carnival weekend
requests.line: It's once a year and we're ALL going.

requests.title: All-night tournament
requests.line: Video games. Dressing room. Till four.

requests.title: My own guru
requests.line: He trains me my way for a month.

requests.title: Ease off the lads
requests.line: They're cooked, boss.

requests.title: My agent sits in
requests.line: He watches training now. He has notes.
